description: Measures GPU read bandwidth per cache level using many streaming threads over a resident window. Sweeping the working-set size traces a bandwidth-vs-size curve that plateaus per level (L1, L2, last-level cache, DRAM). mode=shared has all blocks read one buffer (global/device-wide bandwidth); mode=private gives each block its own buffer (per-unit bandwidth, divide by num_blocks). Reports GB/s.

scaling_param.name: working_set_bytes
scaling_param.description: Resident window size in bytes; selects which cache level serves the reads

non_scaling_params.name: mode
non_scaling_params.description: shared = all blocks read one buffer (global bandwidth); private = each block reads its own buffer (per-unit bandwidth)
